rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: time is a two-level factor with t0 as reference, the design is ~ condition + time + condition:time, the interaction coefficient (Wald, plus LRT vs the reduced ~ condition + time) is the primary test, and simple effects at each time point come as contrasts from the same fit with apeglm/ashr shrinkage; it explicitly refuses a spline/trajectory and the naive set-difference trap. QC is thorough with a stated no-drop/flag policy, the 10-counts-in-3-samples filter is minimal and tied to the replicate number, and raw counts go into DESeq2 without pre-normalization, though size factors are not named. Enrichment was not asked for; what is planned is largely sound (signed interaction Wald stat ranking, filtered universe for ORA, human hallmark/GO-BP named) but omits collection versions and a gene-set size window. Reporting covers method, design, thresholds, gene counts and design caveats but does not commit to reporting package versions.
